scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: mops test Paw && mops test Tiers && mops test Art --mode wasi
scripts.test:integration: mops build && npm --prefix ../frontend run bindings && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:art:full: mops build art-tests && ART_SAMPLES=10000 node --test --test-name-pattern='seeded trees' tests/canisters.test.mjs
